headline: Genesys International submits AGM scrutinizer report and voting results
hook: AGM voting results now on record
summary: Genesys International Corporation Limited has submitted its scrutinizer report and voting results for the Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026, to the stock exchanges. This is a routine post-AGM compliance filing required for listed companies. Indian retail investors holding shares in the company can review the passed resolutions through exchange disclosures.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no immediate impact on share price.
